category_rationale: Necessary for editing screenshots, photos of hardware, or other visual assets integrated into documentation.

do_nothing_test.note: annotated_diagram.png does not exist before agent acts. Returns score=0 immediately.

partial_test.example: Agent exports the unmodified screenshot as annotated_diagram.png. Criteria 1 and 2 pass, but criteria 3 (no changes), 4 (no vivid colors), 5 (no spatial distribution) all fail. Score = 40%.

verification_criteria.label: annotated_diagram.png exists and is valid
verification_criteria.check: File exists on Desktop, is a valid image

verification_criteria.label: Dimensions match source screenshot
verification_criteria.check: Width and height within ±50px of source software_screenshot.png

verification_criteria.label: Image significantly modified from source
verification_criteria.check: Mean pixel diff > 3.0 OR > 2% pixels changed by > 20 value

verification_criteria.label: Contains vivid colored annotation elements
verification_criteria.check: > 0.3% of pixels have saturation > 0.4 and brightness 50-230

verification_criteria.label: Annotations distributed across ≥3 spatial regions
verification_criteria.check: ≥3 of the image's 5×6 grid blocks contain vivid pixels (>2% vivid)

validation_notes: Task was statically validated: syntax checks pass, JSON valid, task discoverable. Do-nothing test yields score=0. Exporting the unmodified screenshot yields ~40% (criteria 1 and 2 pass; 3/4/5 fail).
